Results.ReviewText: I purchased this grill after my prior small Spirit grill rusted apart (after 11 years, no covering).  The new one is superior in that the burners are now perpendicular to the front, making indirect grilling easy. Further, the new racks are solid steel and will last much longer than the prior racks which were shaped steel. I'm not crazy about the propane level sensor, as I'm not strong enough to lift the tank into position, so I'm not using that feature.  All in all, I love this grill!
Results.Title: Excellent smaller grill!

Results.ReviewText:
I have had mine probably around 5 years.
It was great for probably the first 3 years and in the last 2 years the v shape heating elements underneath the
Steel Grates have holes in them and is not cooking the food properly anymore. But this seems to be a common thing that goes bad with all grills. I guess as far as the rest of the grill I would say is 100% top-notch. And would not buy any other grill. I need to be able to find those v shape pieces to replace. And then I think my grill will be as good as new.
Results.Title: Very nice grill

Results.ReviewText: I purchased this a while back and grill throughout the year.  I keep the grill covered when not in use.  I have replaced the consumables as expected, but the sheet metal holding the base has rusted out making it structurally unsound. I purchased with the Weber brand in mind to keep the grill for a VERY long time.  The thin sheet metal holding the base holds water and rusted out.  There is longevity issues with this model of Weber.
Results.Title: Disappointed after some time

Results.ReviewText: I wanted a Weber for a very long time. I finally pulled the trigger and so glad I did. I love this grill. The build quality is what I expected. It is made of materials built to last. I have cooked on it many times already and it still looks like it came out of the box when I put it together. I think that Weber put the starter internals in the propane compartment was genius. You are less likely minus bad equipment to have an issue with the electric spark. The fact that the shelves fold down into two positions as well was smart. It takes a little longer to heat up then I am used to, but I think that is because it is a bit larger than my last grill. I can deal with that still fairly quick. Temp gauge works as it should and does not fog up yet. The locking wheels make it very easy to move around my deck and keep it in place while being used. Finally, the grill grates look like they should hold up much longer than my last grill. Overall, very impressed.
Results.Title: Finally own a Weber grill.

Results.ReviewText: My 1st Weber and the build quality is excellent. I would have given it 5 stars but it has a glitch, you have to have both sides lit or there s a clicking sound if you just want to use one burner.
Results.Title: Great build quality

Results.ReviewText: Materials and assembly are top notch. I was tired of replacing my bbq grill every 3 to 4 years, it sure appears I won’t need to do that, for a very long time.
Results.Title: Looking forward to long term relationship!

Results.ReviewText:
I have owned a Weber Grill for almost 20 years now; they cook well, and they are easy to maintain. I had a small problem with my first grill and the Weber helped me by providing me with the parts that I needed to fix the grill - they stand behind their product.

I very much like the improvements that Weber has made on my new Spirit E-210 grill: drop-down side tables for easier and more compact storage, and heavy, cast iron grates for a better char on meat. They have done this while maintaining the same quality of materials and construction that I experienced with my previous Weber grill. I highly recommend buying one.
Results.Title: My New Weber 2-Burner Spirit Grill

Results.ReviewText: I have been using Weber Spirit grills for over a decade. I first came across one at a rental cabin in Colorado. I ordered my own as soon as we got home. Everything always works including the electric start. This spring I decided to buy a new Spirit Grill. The quality has not declined and if anything it has improved. What we really appreciated was how easy assembly was even for this 83 years old person. I only needed someone to lift the grill part with the gas fixtures onto the base which I had previously assembled. This grill is perfect for the two of us but big enough for a few guests as well.
Results.Title: A Perfect Grill for seniors or a small family.

46110001.Description:
Taste the difference a Spirit will make in your life. With features such as porcelain enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking. Designed to fit on a small patio or balcony, the Spirit E-210 gas grill brings grilling to any home.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 360 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
